|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/iwillfindthemquicklymaster.html</ref>

This key effect, which can be "prepped" with [[Prepared Defenses]] from the [[Death Star II (Dark){{!}}Death Star II]] set, allows you to play with the "capture the Queen" deck type for Episode I. If your opponent is playing with Amidala (Padme), they will be able to pull her out and basically give you an opportunity to capture her.

[[Padme Naberrie]] is sure to show up in some decks since she can call Qui-Gon and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] to come (from the Reserve Deck) and protect her. Once you have her captured with [[Darth Maul]], you can gain all the incredible, eye-opening bonuses from the [[If The Trace Was Correct]] epic event.
